3779.d: The body altar is a runecrafting altar located in Body Rune Temple, which is used to craft body runes from rune essence or pure essence with Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A body talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A body tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A body talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a body altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use the skull sceptre teleport to Barbarian Village, then go north-west to the ruins.
• Use Home Teleport to the Edgeville lodestone and go south to the ruins.
• Use a skills necklace to the Invention Guild and go east to the ruins.
• Use a combat bracelet to the Edgeville Monastery and go south to the ruins.

g.label: Body altar
g.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Body altar'

g.label: Body ruins
g.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Body altar'

3795.d: Bogrog is an ogre in Gu'Tanoth.
3795.ex:
• Ugly and bad-tempered.
• Ugly and bad-tempered (but don't tell him).

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
Getting to Bogrog is fast using the following methods:
• Direct Teleport using a modified shaman's headdress or the Fang of Mohegan
• Get to Yanille:
• Teleport the Yanille lodestone.
• Use the House Teleport spell with a player-owned house in Yanille.
• Use the Watchtower Teleport spell, after completing the hard Ardougne achievements and switching the Watchtower Teleport location to Yanille.
• Use a chipped teleport to house tablet modified to teleport to Yanille, after completing the Love Story quest.
• Get to Bogrog from Yanille.
• Have a Mithril grapple and crossbow or higher. Run to the southern wall, grapple, run to Bogrog and craft pouches. This requires 21 ranged, 39 agility, and 38 strength, and there is a bank in Yanille.
• Go to Castle Wars using the ring of duelling, and run to Bogrog. Players can use a ring of duelling for a quick teleport back to the bank near Castle Wars, or use a TokKul-Zo to get to a bank quickly.
• Take the Gnome glider to Feldip Hills, after completing One Small Favour. Run a short way north from there.

3850.d: The Boneyard is a location found in level 19-23 Wilderness that has four spawns of big bones and ten of normal bones.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use Carrallanger Teleport to the Graveyard of Shadows and run east
• Teleport to the Wilderness Crater lodestone and run east
• Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone and run north
• Players with 57 woodcutting can make a waka just outside the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange and ride it to the lake in level 35 wilderness. Run south-east around the volcano to reach the boneyard

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Boneyard'

3851.d: The boneyard is one of the possible habitat preferences in Herblore Habitat.
3851.ex: A sinister animal graveyard...well, a replica of one.

g.label: Boneyard
g.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Boneyard (Herblore Habitat)'

3852.d: The Boneyard Hunter area is located slightly east of the Boneyard in the Wilderness.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport to the Wilderness lodestone or use Carrallangar Teleport and run east.
• Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone and run north.
• Players with level 57 woodcutting can make a waka canoe just outside the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange and ride it to the lake in level 35 wilderness. Run south-east around the volcano to reach the boneyard.
